entries.note: The delivery facility is preparing the parcel before it goes out with the courier.
The destination carrier's label, relayed before the parcel reaches Huaya's warehouse: order data only. The tracker writes it at "US, SYSTEM, SYSTEM", a place it repeats at the head of the wording.

entries.wording: Your package is being prepared by the sender and will be handed over to us soon
entries.note: The order's data, its first row, hours before the receiving point's first scan: the sender still has the parcel.
The order's data, its first row, written at a country code before the receiving point's first scan in Guangzhou: the sender still has the parcel.

entries.wording: Votre Colissimo va bientôt nous être confié ! Il est en cours de préparation chez votre expéditeur.
entries.note: Colissimo's record of the label, relayed at "FR" before the receiving point's first scan: the sender still has the parcel. The tracker writes the ô as "?".

entries.wording: Votre colis est en transit sur nos plateformes logistiques.
entries.note: Colissimo's transit in France, relayed at "FR" on its Paris clock.

entries.wording: Votre Colissimo est en cours de traitement sur le site de tri local.
entries.note: Colissimo's sort at the local site, before the delivery site.

entries.wording: Votre colis est sur son site de distribution. Nous le préparons pour le mettre en livraison.
entries.note: Colissimo's sort into the delivery round, as La Poste reads its code MD1.

entries.wording: Votre colis est livré dans votre boite aux lettres.
entries.note: Colissimo's delivery to the letterbox.

entries.wording: Shipment not yet received or processed
entries.note: The delivering carrier's row at "NL", relayed hours before the parcel reached Huaya's collection point: order data only.
The first scan in Huaya's hands, at its Guangzhou warehouse, as a universal provider relays it.
Arrived at the receiving point: Huaya's tracker writes its receipt at its Guangzhou warehouse in Chinese, with the kind code ARRIVAL. The parcel is in Huaya's hands.
As a universal provider relays it.
As a universal provider relays it.
As a universal provider relays it.
Huaya's tracker writes it after the hand-over to the airline: the shipment announced to the destination carrier, not the order data.

entries.wording: Package in transit to destination country
entries.note: As a universal provider relays it.
As a universal provider relays it.

entries.wording: Customs import clearance completed, awaiting pickup by local carrier
entries.note: As a universal provider relays it; the local carrier has not taken the parcel yet.

entries.wording: It has been handed over to the service provider.
entries.note: The hand-over to the local carrier in the destination country, as a universal provider relays it; the row names neither.
The US delivery partner's first hub, by Chicago O'Hare, once the parcel has flown there, as DHLink's and SwiftX's maps read it: in transit, not Huaya's acceptance.
The US delivery partner leaving its first hub, after Arrived at Origin Hub.
The US delivery partner's hub nearest the recipient, after Departed Origin Hub: in transit, not yet out for delivery.
The US delivery partner leaving its hub nearest the recipient, after Arrived at Destination Hub.
After Departed Destination Hub: the delivering partner's warehouse, before any delivery round. In transit, not yet out for delivery.
The US delivery partner's round, the morning after Arrived At Warehouse.
The US delivery partner's delivery after its round, at the recipient's town and "Delivery Location".
On the way to the airport, before China's export clearance.
At the airport, before China's export clearance.
China's export clearance done.
Waiting for a flight to be booked.

entries.wording: 航班起飞，预计航班落地时间(…)
entries.note: The flight left, with the day it is due to land ("(10.22)"), which the map reads as an ellipsis.
Landed; import clearance is under way.
After the landing: import clearance done, before the hand-over to the delivering carrier.
Handed to the delivering carrier's warehouse, before its first scan.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically
entries.note: Copied from DHL on the line into Germany: the parcel announced to DHL, on DHL's German clock.

entries.wording: The shipment is in transit to DHL
entries.note: Copied from DHL, before the flight: on its way to DHL.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: Copied from DHL. After a return it is the parcel on its way back.

entries.wording: The shipment arrived in the region of recipient and will be transported to the delivery base in the next step.
entries.note: Copied from DHL. After a return it is the parcel on its way back.

entries.wording: The shipment has been loaded onto the delivery vehicle.
entries.note: Copied from DHL.

entries.wording: The shipment has been loaded onto the delivery vehicle. Delivery is expected to take place today.
entries.note: Copied from DHL.

entries.wording: The recipient could not be found at the address on the shipment.
entries.note: Copied from DHL: the courier's reason for a failed round, as DHL's own map reads it.

entries.wording: Unfortunately delivery of the shipment was not possible. The shipment is returned to the sender.
entries.note: Copied from DHL: the round failed and the parcel goes back. The rows after it are the way back, and the delivery among them is the return's.

entries.wording: The shipment has been sent directly from the parcel center to the business customer.
entries.note: Copied from DHL: delivered from the parcel centre to a business recipient, "ab Paketzentrum dem Geschäftskunden zugestellt" in German (https://www.giga.de/artikel/die-sendung-wurde-ab-paketzentrum-dem-geschaeftskunden-zugestellt-was-bedeutet-das/). After a return it is the return delivered to the sender.

entries.wording: Unfortunately, the shipment could not be delivered. This may be for the following reasons: no name on doorbell; recipient has moved; recipient could not be found based on the address details provided on the shipment.
entries.note: Copied from DHL: a failed round, with the reasons DHL lists for it.

entries.wording: Din leverans ?r bokad med Early Bird.
entries.note: "Your delivery is booked with Early Bird", in Sweden after Huaya's receipt: the delivery handed to Early Bird's last mile. The page writes "ä" as "?".

entries.wording: Out for delivery with the courier
【…】【…】¡Recolección exitosa!. El mensajero de J&T asignado … recolectó tu envío.
entries.note: Copied from J&T Express Mexico, which delivers the last leg on the line into Mexico: its courier collects the cleared parcel. It is not the first acceptance. The town, the site, the courier and what follows the sentence are read as ellipses.

entries.wording: 【…】Tu envío ha salido de【…】con destino a【…】
entries.note: Copied from J&T Express Mexico: the parcel leaves one of its sites for the next. The towns and sites are read as ellipses.
Copied from J&T Express Mexico: the parcel reaches one of its sites.

entries.wording: 【…】【…】El mensajero de J&T Express … está en camino a tu domicilio.
entries.note: J&T Express Mexico's courier on the way to the recipient's home, as JRT's tracker copies it from the same feed on the same platform. The town, the site, the courier and what follows the sentence are read as ellipses.
The Italian last mile's sentence, as Poste Italiane opens its own: the parcel in transit, at a town and its province.
The Italian last mile's round, at the delivering town, the morning after the parcel reached it.

entries.wording: Consegna non andata a buon fine perché l'indirizzo del destinatario risulta errato o incompleto. Contatta assistenza
entries.note: The Italian last mile's round failing hours after it started: the recipient's address is wrong or incomplete, and the recipient is asked to contact support.
The Greek courier's voucher (Συνοδευτικό Δελτίο Ταχυμεταφοράς) created at its station, before the tracker's receipt in China: the last mile's label, not a scan. The page writes "Δημιουργ α".

entries.wording: Pendiente de recepción en CTT Express, ya tenemos todos los detalles de tu envío.Te lo entregaremos muy pronto.
entries.note: Copied from CTT Express, which delivers the last leg in Spain: its notice of the parcel coming, with its data received, while the forwarder still carries it. The page writes no space after the first sentence.
